title: Round 7 stream A: the HUD fades unless hovered (desktop), the HUD's sound chip goes, the build board's cards carry wireframe thumbnails
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, notes 2-4 on b14ed61f (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-7-nine-notes-design.md, stream A): 2) fade every HUD element except the radar to 80 % transparency unless the mouse hovers on it, which brings it to 20 % for a few seconds; 3) remove the note icon for turning the sound off, the user can do that in their system; 4) the build board gets small wireframe thumbnails like the glossary's. Branch round-7-hud off overnight-2026-10-23 at 21eee83a, port 18181, unpushed.
outcome: NOTE 3: #td-pad-sound left index.html, its wiring left src/platform/dev-panel.js (the panel's own `mute` toggle is now the only in-game mute; src/audio.js still restores a stored mute), td-tab's dev panel literal drops `root` (the chip was its only reader), three CSS rules naming it went; test/dev-panel.mjs re-pinned (the log differs from the base's by exactly the chip's two syncs and its click); grep pad-sound over src, scripts, test, css and html is empty. NOTE 2: src/domain/hud-dim.js (HUD_DIM_TARGETS, HUD_DIM_KEEP disjoint by test, hudLit / hudOpacity / insideBox), src/content/hud-dim.js (rest 0.2, lit 0.8, hold 3 s, fade .35 s, scan every 80 ms), src/fx/hud-dim.js (tags the pieces with data-hud, re-tags late arrivals by a childList observer on the tab, lights a piece with hud-lit while the pointer is over its box and for 3 s after), app.css (the look; the ending's td-victory fade still wins). Measured before: nothing dimmed (every HUD piece at its own opacity, 1 or the mode row's .85). After, on --hud-dim: the 13 targets on screen at 0.2 (#td-order absent until an order), the pointer over #td-stats lit it in 368-392 ms (80 ms scan + .35 s fade), 0.8 at 2.6 s after leaving, 0.2 at 3.6 s, the radar 1 at all four samples; ?mobile=1 tags nothing. NOTE 4: src/domain/board-thumbs.js (thumbSource per card kind, thumbKey, fitScale), src/fx/board-thumbs.js (one frame through the glossary's sprite rig, the bestiary's tinted wireframe, a GLB's picture set when it lands, dropped after the board closed by a generation token and isConnected; the clone's geometry is its own so the rig's dispose never frees a model the game draws), BUILD_BOARD.thumb { frame 1.45, centre 0.3 }, .bb-thumb 56 px at the tile's top (the tile 112 -> 168 px tall, no wider). Measured before: no picture on any tile. After, on --board: six of six thumbnails drawn (96 px PNGs) on the sector-1 board (armory, rotor, mortar, shield dome, K0-TECH, relay), both runs six within the step's 5 s bound; frame 1.15 -> 1.45 after the first run's frames read half-empty. td-tab 5,349 -> 5,329 lines and 322,386 -> 321,804 bytes over the three commits, paid by moving spriteShot unchanged into src/fx/wave-card.js (the module that owns the sprite rig); no line over 500.
alternatives: pointerenter / pointerleave on the dimmed pieces (the design): rejected, several of them take no pointer events (the day dial, the hint, the combo) and the canvas sits under the rest; the hover is a box test on the pointer's position, throttled to 80 ms, so the browser step moves the real pointer instead of dispatching pointerenter

dim #td-shop (the build radial) with the controls, as the design's survey listed it: rejected, it is a menu opened on demand (often by B, the pointer elsewhere) whose reading is its purpose; it stays at full with the other menus and modals (#td-auto-radial too)

the hull cards' thumbnail from DEFAULT_TANK's unitIcon (the design): rejected, the icon builder draws a dot cloud and the wireframe hides points, so the tile would stay empty; the hull cards draw the MÖRK's GLB, the bestiary's own picture of the hull
a drawn ring for the shield charges (the design's fallback): a wireframe dome instead, the shield's shape, no model exists
a URL knob named ?phone=1 for the step (the design's wording): the game's flag is ?mobile=1, used as is
